title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Is this true, how much is the deal
I heard you guys hired Jeff Branson to be minor lg hitting coordinator. I am just double checking before I put it out there

I have been busy. My PR guy waited to the last day to do all my MLB interviews 4 today English and Spanish I had the GM/MGR meetings and still sifting through crap that probably won’t come to fruition. So it’s been a busy day. Always is on the last day before the rule 5
And now I have you guys in 6 min. Don’t be late
If I wrote that the likely reason for you guys not announcing the signing was to keep a roster spot open just in case for a second rule 5 pick, would I be in the right direction
Text me when you get back cigar
HOF guys are getting together for a Cigar. I know Alan and Jim Logue will be down smoking. So probably when we get back to Detroit
